name: Screw Lock D Hung Carabiner Keyring
description:
This D-shape keyring is Made of high-quality lightweight aluminum alloy, this D-shaped carabiner is sturdy, durable, rust-resistant and not easy to deform, perfect for long-term daily use.
Ideal for outdoor activities like camping, hiking, traveling, as well as daily use for keys, purses, bags, gadgets and small equipment organization.
summary: Compact size and lightweight structure make it easy to carry. You can clip it on your backpack, belt, keychain or water bottle.
